results.title: Meeting Point
results.overview: Andy, a broken man, is in physical and mental torment as he tries to deal with personal trauma. Unsure where his life is leading him, a chance encounter with a struggling single mother provides them both with a chance to share their stories and comprehend how fate has brought them to this place, this meeting point.

results.title: Troppo azzurro
results.overview: Dario, 25, clings to the equilibrium of his teenage years: he still lives at home with his parents and has the same group of friends from high school. During a sweltering August in Rome, he begins seeing two young women—first Caterina, whom he met by chance, and then Lara, the unattainable girl he has always loved—forcing him to choose between staying in his comfort zone and finally letting go.

results.title: Serial Beauty
results.overview: Angelenos terrorized by a serial killer staging victims. LAPD detectives uncover mystical clues pointing towards an unexpected perpetrator amid scarce evidence.

results.title: Unwell Woman
results.overview: A night at the library turns into a nightmare when a student discovers a haunted painting, unleashing the dark secrets of her long-dead mother...  Blending live action with stop-motion shadow puppetry, this short gothic horror resurrects the monstrous legacy of hysteria, and the medical myths that have made monsters of unmaternal mothers.

results.title: Invited
results.overview: When a reluctant mother attends her daughter's Zoom elopement, she and the rest of the family in attendance quickly realize the groom is part of a Russian cult with deadly intentions.

results.title: Kang Mak from Pee Mak
results.overview: Returning home with his friends, a soldier reunites with his wife, not knowing she's become a ghost. But her death's not the end of their love story.

results.title: The Most Wonderful Time of the Year
results.original_title: The Most Wonderful Time of the Year
results.overview: Sideshow Bob teams up with the most infamous villains of Disney+ to share the true meaning of the Halloween season. Filled with music, mayhem, and madness, this short from "The Simpsons" is simply to die for.

results.title: Shadow Boxing
results.overview: By delving into the life of the girl behind the fighter, Shadow Boxing illuminates the heart of a true warrior, showcasing her courage and resilience long before she enters the ring.

results.title: Dilan 1983
results.overview: In this 1980s prequel, Dilan reunites with his elementary school friends after a year and a half away and tries to impress a new transfer student.

results.title: Domino
results.overview: After his father is murdered by a ruthless villain, An (Thuận Nguyễn) is gradually pulled into the violent underworld of warring gangs. Alone, An must face life-threatening dangers on his own.

results.title: Parallel
results.overview: Grief-stricken after the loss of her child, Vanessa takes refuge at a lake house only to be met with an aberration of herself from a parallel universe and realizes the multiverse gates hold the key to releasing her grief or trapping her forever.

results.title: The Promotion
results.overview: Minerva Cortez, a single mother, joins a course to secure an executive job at a powerful pharmaceutical company. But what seems like a chance for a better life soon becomes a brutal ordeal, forcing her to confront her darkest fears. Trapped and tested alongside her companion Thelma, Minerva discovers a life-altering truth within the nightmare.

results.title: SOLE
results.overview: Sole, a sensually attractive woman, is a fifty-year-old influencer. On the surface, she has everything in life. She enjoys the freedom her job and home offer her. She loves to party and surrounds herself with her followers. She lets herself go and goes with the flow. But when the nighttime fun ends and Sole returns home, everything changes.

results.title: Shitty Liking
results.overview: Sophia and Lilian are not good for each other, but can't let go of each other.

results.title: Aire: Just Breathe
results.overview: It’s year 2147, men are sterile due to a virus leaving humankind almost extinct and Tania, a biologist, is trying to inseminate herself to prevent this with the help of an AI system called VIDA. Things take a turn when Azarias, one of the last men and a traveller with a dark past, suddenly appears.

results.title: Bloody Vamps
results.overview: A world where only women transform into vampires, during their monthly bloody cycle.

results.title: Marauders
results.overview: A father and daughter live life on the fringes of a dystopian future. They kill two survivors of a gang skirmish leading to the arrival of a nefarious man who will hunt them down.

results.title: Space Cadet
results.overview: Tiffany "Rex" Simpson has always dreamed of going to space, and her "doctored" application lands her in NASA's ultra-competitive astronaut training program. In over her head, can this Florida girl rely on her quick wits, moxie and determination to get through training and into the cosmos before she blows her cover?

results.title: Sniper Elite: Nano Crisis
results.overview: Terrorists in the State of S have hijacked a large number of nanobots, which are breakthrough medical nanobots developed by top scientists from many countries around the world, capable of giving countless patients a new life.
